description: dryvist/.github self-config: this repo renovates itself by consuming its own shareable default preset (default.json), exactly like every other dryvist repo. This file is deliberately thin — the shared entry point is default.json, and all policy (auto-merge, trusted orgs, grouping, custom managers) lives in renovate-presets.json + renovate-grouping.json. Put shared changes in those files, never here.
